findings.reason: advisory-suggestion: test_parse_duration_rejects_bad enumerates named invalid CLI duration tokens (zero, negative, garbage, empty, missing unit, unknown unit, missing number); each literal documents a distinct fail-closed contract case, while property generation would obscure the supported grammar boundary. Keep explicit parametrize.

advisory-suggestion: the 7 garbage-payload fail-closed cases are intentionally enumerated literals (each is a named adversarial input — empty/whitespace/permission-prompt/multi-token/unknown-token); hypothesis adds a dependency not used elsewhere in these tests and would obscure the specific fail-closed cases. Keep explicit parametrize.

advisory-suggestion: test_parse_duration_valid enumerates the finite public duration units accepted by the maintenance CLI (seconds, minutes, hours, days). The table is the contract; property generation would add broad parser fuzzing but reduce the named unit-level documentation. Keep explicit parametrize.

advisory-suggestion: test_gate_off_values enumerates 6 named falsy strings (0/false/no/off/OFF/False) for the gate-off path; each is an intentional literal and hypothesis would add a dependency not used elsewhere in these tests while obscuring the specific gate-off cases. Keep explicit parametrize. Mirrors the accepted finding in test_bot_errors_gui_session_monitor.py:199.

advisory-suggestion: test_gate_off_accepts_falsey_values enumerates the finite accepted falsey env values for the inhibition gate (false/no/off/0). These are public compatibility literals, not a broad data domain, so explicit parametrize is clearer and keeps the fail-open contract readable.

advisory-suggestion: test_device_suffixed_jids_fully_masked_across_consumers enumerates the named JID forms whose verbatim leak BEAD-049 fixes (device-suffix :N, device-dash -N, plain) across each of the 7 consumer redactors; each literal is a distinct security regression contract, while property generation would obscure which JID shape proves the WHATSAPP_JID_RE fix. Keep explicit parametrize.
